description: Fixes an issue where when your player id is 0, you can't boost your elytra with fireworks and the fireworks just fly up.
name: Entity 0 Elytra Fix
summary: This fixes a 1.12.2 issue where when your player entity id is 0 you can't use fireworks to boost your elytra

versions.name: working version
versions.changelog: I had an elytra in my single player game, but i havent used it for 2 months, because the fireworks just never worked. I tried searching for a solution, nothing worked for me. Because of that, i created this mod, which FIXES THIS ST*PID ISSUE.
